function named<T extends { name: string }, K extends keyof T>(record: T, key: K): number {
  return record[key].length;
}

function numbered<T extends { [index: number]: string }>(record: T, key: keyof T): number {
  return record[key].length;
}

function bySymbol(record: Record<string, string>, key: symbol): string {
  return record[key];
}

function asNumber<T extends Record<string, string>>(record: T, key: keyof T): number {
  const value: number = record[key];
  return value;
}

function accepted<T extends Record<string, string>>(record: T, key: keyof T): number {
  return record[key].length;
}
